title: ServerMessage
description: A message from the server to a client.

oneOf.description: Answers a `hello` message. It proves that the server has its key.

key.description: The public key of the server.

nonce.description: A random value that the server makes for this connection.

proof.description: The signature of the server key for this connection.

protocol.description: The protocol version of the session.

ref.description: The number from the `hello` message, if it had one.

requires.description: The optional parts of the protocol that a client must support.

oneOf.description: Starts the session of a user. The session now has a name.

name.description: The name of the user in this session.

ref.description: The number from the message that the server accepts, if it had one.

role.description: The role of the user on this server.

oneOf.description: Gives the state of a channel to one of its members.

channel.description: The name of the channel, without the `#` sign.

created.description: The time when the owner made the channel.

owner.description: The name of the owner of the channel.

ref.description: The number from the request. Only the connection that sent the request gets this field.

topic.description: The topic of the channel. The topic can be empty.

oneOf.description: Tells that the state after the sign-in is complete.
Gives a part of the channel list of the server.

list.description: The channels of this part, in the sequence of their names.

more.description: The value `true` tells that a later message gives more channels.

ref.description: The number from the request, if it had one.

oneOf.description: Tells that a user came into a channel.

channel.description: The name of the channel, without the `#` sign.

time.description: The time when the user came in.

oneOf.description: Tells that a user went out of a channel.

channel.description: The name of the channel, without the `#` sign.

ref.description: The number from the `leave` message. Only the connection that sent it gets this field.

time.description: The time when the user went out.

oneOf.description: Carries a text that a user sent to a channel.

channel.description: The name of the channel, without the `#` sign.

ref.description: The number from the `send` message. Only the sender gets this field.

time.description: The time when the server got the message.

oneOf.description: Gives the open invitations of the server. The newest invitation is first.

ref.description: The number from the request, if it had one.

oneOf.description: Tells that a user has a new name.

new.description: The new name of the user.

old.description: The earlier name of the user.

ref.description: The number from the `rename` message. Only the connection that sent it gets this field.

oneOf.description: Tells that a channel has a new topic.

by.description: The name of the user who changed the topic.

channel.description: The name of the channel, without the `#` sign.

ref.description: The number from the `channel-topic` message. Only the connection that sent it gets this field.

topic.description: The new topic of the channel. The topic can be empty.

oneOf.description: Tells that a channel has a new name.

channel.description: The earlier name of the channel, without the `#` sign.

name.description: The new name of the channel.

ref.description: The number from the `channel-rename` message. Only the connection that sent it gets this field.

oneOf.description: Tells that a channel has a new owner.

channel.description: The name of the channel, without the `#` sign.

name.description: The name of the new owner.

ref.description: The number from the `channel-give` message. Only the connection that sent it gets this field.

oneOf.description: Tells that the owner deleted a channel.

channel.description: The name of the channel, without the `#` sign.

ref.description: The number from the `channel-delete` message. Only the connection that sent it gets this field.

time.description: The time when the owner deleted the channel.

oneOf.description: Tells that a user has an invitation to a private channel.

channel.description: The name of the channel, without the `#` sign.

name.description: The name of the invited user.

owner.description: The name of the owner of the channel.

ref.description: The number from the `channel-invite` message. Only the connection that sent it gets this field.

time.description: The time when the owner made the invitation.

oneOf.description: Refuses a message from the client.

code.description: The cause of the error, for a program.

ref.description: The number from the refused message, if it had one.

text.description: The cause of the error in English, for a person.

oneOf.description: Each member of the server can join the channel.
An invitation from the owner is necessary to join the channel.

ChannelName.description: The name of a channel: 2 to 30 characters from a to z, 0 to 9, hyphen, and underscore.

Code.description: The code of an invitation: 12 letters and digits.

oneOf.description: The line is not a valid protocol message.
The server does not support the protocol version of the client.
The client sent a different message before the `hello` message.
The client sent a second `hello` message.
The server does not answer to the address that the client used.
The client sent a message that is only for a user with a session.
The client sent a sign-in message after a `welcome` message.
The signature does not agree with the key and this connection.
The server has no account for the key.
The key already has an account.
The invitation does not exist, or it is not open.
The client does not support a part of the protocol that the server requires.
The name does not obey the rules for a name.
A different user has the name, or the name is reserved.
The channel does not exist.
The text has no visible character.
The text has too many characters.
The account does not have the permission for the request.
The account or the channel changed its name a short time ago.
The name does not obey the rules for a channel name.
The account owns the maximum number of channels.
The user is already a member of the channel.
The user is not a member of the channel.
The owner of a channel cannot leave it.
The topic does not obey the rules for a topic.
The server has no user with the name.
The channel has no member with the name.
The channel is public, thus it has no invitations.
The user already has an invitation to the channel.
The server has a problem and cannot do the task.

Invitation.description: An open invitation to a server.

created.description: The time when the server made the invitation.

end.description: The time when the invitation ends. Without this field, it has no end.

link.description: The invite link. A person pastes it into an application.

used.description: The number of accounts that the invitation made.

uses.description: The number of accounts that the invitation can make. Without this field, it has no limit.

Key.description: A public key: 32 bytes as base64url text with no `=` characters.

ListedChannel.description: A channel in the channel list.

channel.description: The name of the channel, without the `#` sign.

members.description: The number of the members of the channel.

topic.description: The topic of the channel. The topic can be empty.

Name.description: The name of a user: 2 to 20 characters from a to z, 0 to 9, hyphen, and underscore.

Nonce.description: A random value: 32 bytes as base64url text with no `=` characters.

Part.description: The word for an optional part of the protocol: 2 to 20 lower-case letters and hyphens.

Role.description: The role of an account on a server.

oneOf.description: The account owns the server.
The account is a normal member.

Signature.description: A signature: 64 bytes as base64url text with no `=` characters.

Timestamp.description: A time in UTC with milliseconds, for example 2026-11-21T14:02:07.120Z.
